# RAGbase Shield verbs (French). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# French verbs for the lower-case name rules (v0.4.1): a name typed in lower case stops at a verb ("m. samir
# conteste"), and a word that is a verb form is not a name ("madame demande", "monsieur verse"). The loader
# (lexicon.verb_forms) conjugates the infinitives on folded text (lower case, no accents): present, imperfect,
# future, conditional, present subjunctive, imperative and participles. No simple past and no imperfect
# subjunctive: typed text does not use them, and their endings ("-a", "-as") are the endings of many names.
# Sections: "# [er]" first group, "# [ir]" second group (like "finir"), "# [models]" one line for each model of
# the third group ("name: what the infinitive loses | endings", "0" is the empty ending), then one section for each
# model with its verbs, "# [auxiliaries]" every form of the auxiliary and modal verbs (never a name word, also
# when the form is a first name), "# [forms]" forms the models do not give. Several entries on a line.
# A few rare verbs are left out on purpose, because their forms are frequent surnames.

# [er]
